title: Christie’s London Sales Total $289 Million
summary: The London auction house Christie’s brought in $289.4 million over two evening sales on Wednesday, October 14—the 20/21st Century Evening Sale and the “Monsoon,” sale of the collection of Peter Simon. summary: A pen-and-brown-ink drawing by eighteenth-century Italian master Canaletto that remained out of public view for hundreds of years is set to hit the auction block on October 21, Artnet News reports. summary: The first edition of Rubaiya Qatar, a new quadrennial in Doha, opens next month and will host more than 120 artists from around the world, including Algeria, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Iran, Nepal, Palestine, the Philippines, Sudan, and Thailand. title: Danh Võ and Yohji Yamamoto Win 2026 Isamu Noguchi Award
summary: Vietnamese-born artist Danh Võ and Japanese fashion designer Yohji Yamamoto have been announced as the recipients of the thirteenth Isamu Noguchi Award. summary: Artist Peter Nagy, whose Nature Morte gallery was instrumental in bringing contemporary Indian art to the attention of international audiences, died on October 13 in New Delhi following a long illness.
